label: A7B2C_mC80_12_g5i4j_hij_2i-001
title: $\alpha$-KHo$_{2}$F$_{7}$ Structure
comments:
This is the low-temperature structure of KHo$_{2}$F$_{7}$.  At higher temperatures it transforms in to the \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B7C_oP80_62_2cd_6c4d_2c-001}{$\beta$-KEr$_{2}$F$_{7}$} structure. 
 (le Fur, 1982) placed this structure in the non-centrosymmetric $Cm$ \#8 space group.  (Marsh, 1988) found that the structure could be equally well refined in centrosymmetric $C2/m$. 
 The default AFLOW parameterization of this structure rather severely distorts the monoclinic unit cell, changing the angle $\beta$ from 125.33$^\circ$ to 144.257$^\circ$. Although of course it produces an equivalent structure, wee have chosen to use the more compact experimental discription of the lattice here.
